services.name: PD Day Camps
services.desc: Located at the Halifax Grammar School, 945 Tower Rd, Halifax NS, as well as Neptune Theatre, 1593 Argyle Street, Halifax NS. New to Neptune Camps? Or maybe this is your favourite place and you cannot wait to come back for more? During our week-long camp, students will have fun learning drama games, songs, and activities culminating with a performance on the last day for family and friends! Our teen programs vary in length, theme, and skill-intensity with new offerings each summer. Camps are offered in three age groups at the Grammar School: ages 4-6, ages 7-9, and ages 10-12. services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Central, hospitable and extremely flexible, Neptune Theatre has the perfect space for your event. Get in touch with us for a consultation and cost estimate. This proscenium theatre can host many types of performances and presentations. It comes with a 45-foot fly tower. It has a balcony and an orchestra level, and it includes the Spatz and Royal Bank Lounges as part of the rental. This intimate theatre can be used for many purposes, and it can also be staged for in-the-round performances. It comes with the Grant Thornton Lounge included in the rental. Ideal for: Theatrical Performances, Presentations, Graduations, Conferences, Wedding Ceremonies, Dance
